name: LocalGuard
description: Control parental para navegadores. Bloquea sitios no permitidos y reporta el historial al panel de LocalGuard.
author: LocalGuard

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://localguard.pro https://*.localguard.pro; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self';
